text:
alex: pushed reranker v2 to staging and ran the usual bench. weird signal: NDCG@10 +1.8% but MRR@10 -3% on the holdout. short-queries slice hit hardest.
sam: did you run with quantization? what backend/recipe?
alex: yes int8 PTQ (per-channel, dynamic). fp32 baseline shows smaller delta (ndcg +1.0, mrr -0.5). same candidate ordering preserved.
maria: did preprocessing change? we recently flipped the sanitizer to keep basic tags for snippet extraction.
alex: good call — i pulled the eval config: html_strip=false in the staging pipeline. i normally run with html_strip=true locally.
sam: can you paste the eval command you used?
alex: ```
./eval_rerank \\--gold holdout_v2.json \\--pred preds_v2_rerankv2.json \\--metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 \\--slices short_queries,long_queries \\--tokenizer sentencepiece_v2 \\--preproc-config preproc.yaml
```
maria: that preproc.yaml is the one that changed last week (keeps <code>/<a> for snippet). if HTML tokens remain, tokenization and priming length can shift ordering for short queries.
alex: reran with html_strip=true and re-evaluated: quantized run now ndcg +0.9, mrr +0.1. so the big MRR drop disappeared.
sam: ok so it's an interaction: quantization amplifies sensitivity to formatting differences for short queries. interesting.
maria: we should add a gating checklist for model onboarding: dataset parity (preproc), sanitizer parity, short-query slice smoke, fp32 vs int8 comparison artifacts.
alex: i'll open a PR to the onboarding checklist and attach artifacts (plots + diffs). uploading artifacts to staging s3: s3://redwood-eval/artifacts/rerank/v2/1711171234/
ci-bot: deploy pipeline finished: staging rollout succeeded at 2026-03-22T14:12:03Z :white_check_mark:
sam: can we add a simple CI smoke that runs a short-query slice and fails if MRR drops > 2% relative to the latest golden? Prefer a quick ~200 query sample so it's fast.
maria: +1 — also add an assertion that preproc checksum matches golden (so sanitizer changes are caught).
alex: created a small script reproduce_small.sh in the PR; it downloads holdout slice, runs eval, and checks thresholds. will link in PR.
sam: sounds good. after checklist and CI, let's rebaseline the metric dashboards and note that earlier gap was preproc-induced.
maria: thanks for digging in quickly. can you annotate the model card with the quantization sensitivity note?
alex: yep will add "quantization amplifies formatting mismatches, watch short-query MRR" in model card.
sam: nice detective work :detective:
maria: resolving — follow-ups: PR for checklist, CI smoke, model card update, artifacts uploaded.
